complete_examples.text: To overcome the bottleneck of PDEM, Yang and Chen [27,28] recently derived the probability density integral equation (PDIE) of stochastic systems, and developed corresponding the direct probability integral method (DPIM) to solve PDIE, their methodology has been proven to be highly accurate and efficient in uncertainty quantification and reliability evaluation of some simple stochastic static and dynamic systems.
In Ref. [27], the trans formation method of random variables was adopted to deduce the probability density integral equation (PDIE).

The probability density integral equation (PDIE) and direct probability integration method (DPIM) were introduced to develop the stochastic dynamic equation of the train-track-bridge system and the corresponding calculation and solution strategy.
